name: ayni_sdk
desc: The public integration contract of package:ayni_sdk (US-090).

name: AyniConfig
desc: Configuration required to initialize the Ayni SDK.

name: AyniConfig.new
desc: Creates an SDK configuration instance.

name: allowInsecureLoopback
desc: Whether insecure HTTP is permitted for local loopback development.

name: credential
desc: The SDK secret credential (ayni_sk_...).

name: isValid
desc: Whether this configuration is complete and valid for SDK initialization.

name: maxEvidenceUploadAttempts
desc:
How many times AyniSdk.sync tries to upload an evidence for datasets
before it stops. Defaults to 5 and must be at least 1.

name: onProgress
desc: Optional callback to receive human-readable progress messages.

name: serverUrl
desc:
The server URL for the Ayni API (must use HTTPS, or HTTP for loopback
when allowInsecureLoopback is true).

name: storageDirectory
desc: Directory where the SDK stores workflows, models, and sync inventory.

name: syncTimeout
desc: Maximum duration for a sync operation. Defaults to 30 seconds.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: AyniInitializationResult
desc: The result of an SDK initialization attempt.

name: AyniInitializationResult.new
desc: Creates an initialization result.

name: isReady
desc: Whether initialization was successful and the SDK is ready for use.

name: isSuccess
desc: Whether initialization was successful and the SDK is ready for use.

name: message
desc: Human-readable message describing the initialization outcome.

name: sdk
desc: The initialized AyniSdk instance, or null if initialization failed.

name: status
desc: The status of the initialization attempt.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: AyniSdk
desc: Manages synchronization and offline execution of workflows.

name: AyniSdk.new
desc: Creates a new AyniSdk instance directly.

name: allowInsecureLoopback
desc:
Whether serverUrl may use plain HTTP to localhost or a loopback
address, for local development. Defaults to false.

name: cancelExecution
desc: Requests cancellation of an active execution.

name: clearPendingEvidence
desc: Deletes the evidence for datasets saved on this device (US-066).

name: clearPendingTraces
desc: Deletes pending validation traces after the host revokes that permission.

name: createClientExecutionTrace
desc: Builds an in-memory trace for a control execution performed by the host.

name: evidenceQueueStatus
desc:
The state of the queue of evidence for datasets pending upload on this
device (US-069), for example to show Pendiente de Wi-Fi.

name: evidenceStatusCounts
desc:
How many evidences for datasets kept on this device are in each
EvidenceStatus (US-071), for example to show how many are Fallida.
Every status is in the map, with 0 when no evidence has it.

name: getDeviceProfile
desc: Reads the allowlisted device and operating-system profile on this device.

name: initialize
desc: Initializes the shared AyniSdk singleton with the provided config.

name: initializeAsync
desc: Asynchronously initializes the shared AyniSdk singleton with config.

name: instance
desc: Returns the shared AyniSdk instance configured by initialize.

name: isInitialized
desc: Whether the SDK has been successfully initialized.

name: maxEvidenceUploadAttempts
desc:
How many times sync tries to upload an evidence for datasets without
a confirmation from the server before it stops (US-071). Defaults to 5:
the first upload and up to four retries.

name: onProgress
desc: Reports SDK activity, including Descargando workflow <nombre>….

name: pendingEvidenceCount
desc:
How many evidences for datasets are pending upload on this device
(US-068), for example to show Evidencia pendiente de envío while it is
more than zero.

name: recordConsent
desc: Records one user's explicit choice for one optional Ayni-owned purpose.

name: resetForTesting
desc: Resets the shared SDK singleton for testing.

name: resetInstallationId
desc: Replaces the installation UUID used by traces created from now on.

name: run
desc:
Executes the last locally installed, validated version of workflowId.
input is the encoded image bytes (for example JPEG or PNG).

name: serverUrl
desc:
The Ayni server the SDK syncs with; sync posts to its /sdk/sync
path.

name: setPlatformForTesting
desc: Sets platform configuration overrides for testing.

name: storageDirectory
desc:
The directory where the SDK keeps the installed workflow definitions,
models, and the sync inventory that run reads.

name: supportedWorkflowSchemaVersions
desc: The workflow schema versions supported by this SDK release (US-098).

name: sync
desc:
Downloads and installs the workflow versions published for the
credential's application, with the models they need.

name: syncTimeout
desc: The longest a sync call may take. Defaults to 30 seconds.

name: AyniSdkConfig
desc: Alias for AyniConfig.

name: BooleanResult
desc: The output of a condition node.

name: BooleanResult.new
desc: Creates the result of condition node nodeId.

name: value
desc: Whether the condition held for the classification it evaluated.

name: ClassificationResult
desc: The output of a classification model node.

name: ClassificationResult.new
desc: Creates a classification whose best label scored confidence.

name: confidence
desc: The score of label, from 0 to 1.

name: confidences
desc: The score of every label the model declares, from 0 to 1.

name: label
desc: The label with the highest score.

name: CombinedWorkflowResult
desc: Results declared by one output node that combines multiple sources.

name: CombinedWorkflowResult.new
desc: Creates a combined output from each available declared source.

name: values
desc: Typed values in the same order as the output's declared sources.

name: ConsentDecision
desc: The user's explicit answer for one ConsentPurpose.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: ConsentPurpose
desc: Optional Ayni-owned uses of data. Each purpose requires its own choice.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: wireValue
desc: Stable value sent to the Ayni API.

name: ConsentResult
desc: Result of saving one consent choice locally and, when online, on Ayni.

name: ConsentResult.new
desc: Creates the result of a consent operation.

name: message
desc: A short Spanish message suitable for the host application's UI.

name: status
desc: Whether the receipt was synchronized, queued locally, or could not be saved.

name: ConsentStatus
desc: Whether an explicit consent decision reached Ayni.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: Detection
desc: One object found by a detection model node.

name: Detection.new
desc: Creates a detection of label inside the given box.

name: confidence
desc: The detection score, from 0 to 1.

name: label
desc: The label of the detected object.

name: xMax
desc: The box's right edge, relative to the image width (0 to 1).

name: xMin
desc: The box's left edge, relative to the image width (0 to 1).

name: yMax
desc: The box's bottom edge, relative to the image height (0 to 1).

name: yMin
desc: The box's top edge, relative to the image height (0 to 1).

name: DetectionResult
desc: The output of a detection model node.

name: DetectionResult.new
desc: Creates the result of node nodeId with its detections.

name: detections
desc:
The objects whose score reached the node's score threshold; it can be
empty.

name: DeviceProfile
desc: Allowlisted, versioned device metadata returned by AyniSdk.getDeviceProfile.

name: DeviceProfile.new
desc: Creates a device profile with the fields available to the caller.

name: apiLevel
desc: Android API level, or null on platforms that do not expose it.

name: currentSchemaVersion
desc: Current version of the serialized profile shape.

name: model
desc: User-visible device model, when available.

name: osVersion
desc: User-visible operating system version, when available.

name: platform
desc: Platform name: android, ios, or unknown.

name: ramRange
desc: Coarse physical-memory range, when available.

name: schemaVersion
desc: Version of the serialized profile shape.

name: socModel
desc: SoC model exposed by the platform, when available.

name: toJson
desc: Serializes only the explicit device-profile allowlist.

name: EvidenceEvent
desc:
What the SDK did with an evidence for datasets: the events of its capture,
reported to the onEvidence callback of AyniSdk.run (US-066 to
US-068), and those of its upload, reported to the onEvidence callback of
AyniSdk.sync (US-070). The SDK also reports each message to
AyniSdk.onProgress.

name: message
desc:
A Spanish message for diagnostics, which the SDK also reports through
AyniSdk.onProgress: Optimizando,
Evidencia preparada para envío.,
Evidencia guardada para envío posterior.,
No se pudo preparar una evidencia. El resultado del análisis no se vio afectado.,
No se pudo guardar una imagen para el dataset; el análisis se completó normalmente.,
Subiendo evidencia…, Evidencia recibida.,
No se pudo enviar la evidencia; se reintentará cuando sea posible.,
No se puede enviar evidencia porque la credencial fue revocada.
or
No se pudo enviar la evidencia después de varios intentos.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: EvidenceQueueStatus
desc:
The state of the local queue of evidence for datasets pending upload on
this device, which AyniSdk.evidenceQueueStatus reports (US-069).

name: message
desc:
A Spanish text the app can show for this state:
Sin evidencia pendiente de envío, Evidencia pendiente de envío or
Pendiente de Wi-Fi.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: EvidenceStatus
desc:
The state of one evidence for datasets kept on this device, which
AyniSdk.evidenceStatusCounts counts (US-071, US-072).

name: message
desc:
A Spanish text the app can show for this state: Pendiente,
Enviando, Reintentando, Enviada or Fallida.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: InitializationResult
desc: Alias for AyniInitializationResult.

name: InitializationStatus
desc: Status indicating the outcome of SDK initialization.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: SegmentationResult
desc: The output of a segmentation model node: one label for every pixel.

name: SegmentationResult.new
desc: Creates the segmentation of node nodeId.

name: areaFractions
desc:
The fraction of the mask each label covers, from 0 to 1, for every
label the model declares. The fractions add up to 1, except for
rounding.

name: confidence
desc:
The mean, over every pixel, of the score of the label that won it, from
0 to 1.

name: height
desc: The mask's height in pixels: the model's output height.

name: labelAt
desc:
The label of the pixel at column x and row y, counted from the top
left corner of the mask.

name: labels
desc: The labels the model declares; a mask value is an index into this list.

name: mask
desc:
The index into labels of every pixel, row by row (width * height
values). It cannot be modified.

name: width
desc: The mask's width in pixels: the model's output width.

name: SyncResourceResult
desc: The outcome of one workflow or model during an AyniSdk.sync.

name: SyncResourceResult.new
desc: Creates the result of one resource.

name: dependencyName
desc:
The model version ID of the dependency that failed, for
SyncResourceStatus.dependencyFailed (US-044); null otherwise.

name: message
desc:
A Spanish message that explains the outcome, or null when status is
SyncResourceStatus.updated or SyncResourceStatus.upToDate.

name: name
desc:
The workflow's name, or null for models and for invalid server
entries.

name: previousVersionRetained
desc:
Whether a valid local version of this workflow was kept when the update
was rejected (US-042, US-098).

name: remoteHashConflict
desc:
Whether the server published a model with the installed version number
but a different SHA-256 hash.

name: resourceVersionId
desc:
The ID of the workflow version or model version, or null when the
server listed the resource without a valid one.

name: status
desc: What happened to the resource during the sync.

name: type
desc: Whether this result describes a workflow or a model.

name: version
desc:
The version the server published, such as 1.2.0, or null when the
server listed the resource without a valid one.

name: SyncResourceStatus
desc:
The outcome of one workflow or model during an AyniSdk.sync, in
SyncResourceResult.status.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: SyncResourceType
desc: The kind of resource a SyncResourceResult describes.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: SyncResult
desc: The outcome of an AyniSdk.sync call.

name: SyncResult.new
desc:
Creates a sync result with its overall status and the outcome of each
resource.

name: resources
desc:
The outcome of every workflow and model the server listed, except a new
model that was removed again because the workflow that needed it failed.

name: status
desc: The overall outcome of the sync.

name: SyncStatus
desc: The overall outcome of an AyniSdk.sync call, in SyncResult.status.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: TraceMeasurement
desc: A finite client-reported measurement with its unit and method.

name: TraceMeasurement.new
desc: Creates a finite measurement with explicit units and provenance.

name: method
desc: Collection or calculation method.

name: name
desc: Measurement name.

name: phase
desc: Execution phase to which the value applies.

name: source
desc: Client-declared measurement source.

name: toJson
desc: Serializes the measurement with clientReported provenance.

name: unit
desc: Unit for value.

name: value
desc: Preserved numeric value.

name: TraceModel
desc: A model version referenced by an execution trace.

name: TraceModel.new
desc: Identifies one model artifact used or reported by the execution.

name: modelVersionId
desc: Model version identifier.

name: sha256
desc: SHA-256 of the model artifact.

name: toJson
desc: Serializes the model reference.

name: version
desc: Published model version string.

name: TraceNodeExecution
desc: One workflow node's sanitized outcome and elapsed time.

name: TraceNodeExecution.new
desc: Creates a sanitized node phase outcome.

name: durationMs
desc: Elapsed node time in milliseconds, or null when the node was not executed.

name: modelVersionId
desc: Model version attempted by this node, when applicable.

name: nodeId
desc: Workflow node identifier.

name: status
desc: Node outcome: completed, skipped, or failed.

name: toJson
desc: Serializes the node outcome.

name: type
desc: Published workflow node type.

name: WorkflowError
desc: The error AyniSdk.run throws when a workflow cannot be executed.

name: WorkflowError.new
desc:
Creates an error of category, optionally naming the node and the model
version involved.

name: category
desc: Why the workflow could not be executed.

name: modelVersionId
desc:
The model version involved in the failure, or null when no model is
involved.

name: nodeId
desc:
The ID of the workflow node that failed, or null when the error does
not come from a single node.

name: trace
desc: Sanitized local trace, when policy and caller context enabled capture.

name: tracePersistenceFailed
desc: Whether the trace could not be persisted to the local outbox.

name: withTrace
desc: Returns an equivalent typed error carrying value, when provided.

name: WorkflowErrorCategory
desc:
Why AyniSdk.run could not execute a workflow, in
WorkflowError.category.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: WorkflowResult
desc: The outputs of a successful AyniSdk.run.

name: WorkflowResult.new
desc:
Creates the result of running version workflowVersion of
workflowId.

name: executionId
desc: The identifier assigned to this execution.

name: outputs
desc:
The value of each output node the execution reached, keyed by the
output's name.

name: trace
desc: Sanitized local trace, when policy and caller context enabled capture.

name: tracePersistenceFailed
desc: Whether the trace could not be persisted to the local outbox.

name: usingOfflineCache
desc:
Whether the workflow ran from the resources stored on the device, which
AyniSdk.run always does.

name: withTrace
desc: Returns an equivalent result carrying value, when provided.

name: workflowId
desc: The ID of the workflow that ran.

name: workflowVersion
desc: The installed version of the workflow that ran, such as 1.2.0.

name: WorkflowTrace
desc: Local, versioned, privacy-limited evidence for one workflow execution.

name: clientReportedFields
desc: Context properties reported by the client.

name: context
desc: Caller-declared experiment context.

name: currentSchemaVersion
desc: Current schema version for serialized traces.

name: durationMs
desc: Total duration in milliseconds.

name: encodeOutputs
desc:
Encodes only the SDK's typed, decoded public outputs; input bytes and
arbitrary tensors have no path into this allowlist.

name: error
desc: Typed error fields, with no raw exception message.

name: installationId
desc: Random per-installation identifier stored by the SDK.

name: models
desc: Model references used or attempted by the execution.

name: nodes
desc: Sanitized node outcomes and timings.

name: outputs
desc: Structured decoded outputs only.

name: profile
desc: Allowlisted platform profile and optional client fallbacks.

name: repetition
desc: Caller-declared repetition number.

name: runId
desc: Caller-declared run identifier.

name: status
desc: success or error.

name: timestamp
desc: UTC time at which the workflow execution started.

name: toJson
desc: Serializes the complete allowlisted trace schema.

name: traceId
desc: Unique trace identifier.

name: workflowId
desc: Executed workflow identifier.

name: workflowVersion
desc: Published workflow version string.

name: workflowVersionId
desc: Immutable workflow version identifier.

name: WorkflowTraceContext
desc: Caller-declared identifiers and validation context for one run.

name: WorkflowTraceContext.new
desc: Creates a caller-reported context, requiring a non-empty run ID and positive repetition.

name: appCommit
desc: Application source commit, when declared.

name: appVersion
desc: Host application version, when declared.

name: backend
desc: Effective backend reported by the application.

name: batteryPercent
desc: Battery level in percent, from 0 through 100.

name: caseId
desc: Application-declared case identifier.

name: condition
desc: Experimental condition such as control or treatment.

name: datasetId
desc: Dataset identifier, when declared.

name: datasetPartition
desc: Dataset partition, when declared.

name: datasetSha256
desc: Dataset or input hash, when declared.

name: incidents
desc: Application-declared incidents for this run.

name: measurements
desc: External measurements with units and collection provenance.

name: network
desc: Network condition reported by the application.

name: ramRange
desc: RAM bucket supplied only when the SDK profile does not expose one.

name: repetition
desc: One-based application-declared repetition number.

name: runId
desc: Application-declared run ID; the SDK never generates this value.

name: scenario
desc: Application-declared scenario description or identifier.

name: sdkCommit
desc: SDK source commit, when declared.

name: sdkVersion
desc: SDK version, when declared by the host.

name: socModel
desc: SoC model supplied only when the SDK profile does not expose one.

name: temperatureC
desc: Temperature in degrees Celsius, if measured by the application.

name: toJson
desc: Serializes the context without inventing absent values.

name: validity
desc: Application-declared validity judgment, if available.

name: WorkflowValue
desc:
A value a workflow node produced: a ClassificationResult, a
DetectionResult, a SegmentationResult, a BooleanResult, or a
CombinedWorkflowResult.

name: nodeId
desc: The ID of the workflow node that produced this value.
